description:
Senior Full-Stack Developer (Angular / .NET Core)

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Developer with strong Angular and .NET expertise who knows how to leverage AI to build and ship features faster. Join a growing engineering team developing a healthcare revenue cycle management platform that streamlines insurance claims, billing, and financial workflows for radiology and outpatient imaging services. You'll help expand a web application, deliver high-impact features, and contribute to its future AI-powered automation capabilities.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and enhance a web application using Angular 12, ASP.NET Core 8 (C#), and SQL Server.

  • Build and deliver new features, including internal messaging, task management, and collaborative workflows for healthcare billing operations.

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize REST APIs, backend services, and database functionality to support application performance and scalability.

  • Implement and maintain integrations with internal and external systems, including NCS and Microsoft Fabric.

  • Leverage AI-powered coding tools to accelerate development, streamline debugging, and improve overall engineering productivity.

  • Collaborate with a six-person development team, including senior engineers, QA, and the VP of Development, to deliver reliable, high-quality features.


Requirements

  • Strong senior-level full-stack development experience, with hands-on expertise in Angular 12, ASP.NET Core 8, and C#.

  • Solid experience with SQL Server, including database development, optimization, and integration with backend applications.

  • Proven ability to develop and maintain REST APIs and web applications hosted on IIS/Windows.

  • Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, troubleshooting, and feature delivery.

  • Experience integrating enterprise applications with external systems; familiarity with NCS and Microsoft Fabric is highly preferred.

  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to independently own feature development and work effectively during U.S. Eastern Time hours.
